teaser.en: The Digo call it 'the acacia with claws', and anyone caught in its hooked thorns will understand why.
teaser.sw: Wadigo wanakiita 'mgunga wenye kucha', na yeyote aliyenaswa na miiba yake iliyopinda kama ndoano ataelewa kwa nini.

summary.en: *Chikwata kombe* is the hook-thorn, a dry-country acacia armed with pairs of strongly hooked thorns. It gives firewood and fodder, and its cream flowers are rich in nectar for bees.
summary.sw: *Chikwata kombe* (kwa Kiingereza *hook-thorn*) ni mgunga wa maeneo makavu uliojihami kwa jozi za miiba iliyopinda sana kama ndoano. Hutoa kuni na lishe ya mifugo, na maua yake ya rangi ya krimu yana mbochi nyingi kwa nyuki.

about.en:
*Chikwata kombe* is a shrub or small tree, often growing as a tangle of stems. Its branches carry pairs of short, strongly hooked thorns, curved like claws, that snag clothing and skin. The leaves are feathery, made of small paired leaflets.

In flower it is covered in creamy, fluffy spikes with a sweet scent, which draw bees from far around.
about.sw:
*Chikwata kombe* ni kichaka au mti mdogo, mara nyingi ukiota kama kichaka cha mashina yaliyosokotana. Matawi yake hubeba jozi za miiba mifupi iliyopinda sana kama ndoano, iliyojikunja kama kucha, inayonasa nguo na ngozi. Majani yake ni kama manyoya, yaliyoundwa kwa vijani vidogo vilivyopangwa kwa jozi.

Unapochanua hufunikwa na mashada ya maua ya rangi ya krimu, laini kama pamba, yenye harufu tamu, yanayowavuta nyuki kutoka mbali.

where.en: It grows in dry bushland, in the drier country inland from the coast. It is easiest to notice when flowering, when whole bushes turn cream.
where.sw: Huota katika vichaka vikavu, katika maeneo makavu zaidi yaliyo bara mbali na pwani. Ni rahisi zaidi kuuona unapochanua, wakati vichaka vizima vinapogeuka rangi ya krimu.

uses.en: It is cut for firewood and browsed as fodder. The hook-thorn is famous across East Africa as a honey plant: its flowers give bees plenty of nectar.
uses.sw: Hukatwa kwa kuni na hulishwa na mifugo. Mti huu ni maarufu Afrika Mashariki kote kama mmea wa asali: maua yake huwapa nyuki mbochi kwa wingi.

culture.en: The name means 'acacia with claws': *chikwata* is the general Digo name for acacias, and *kombe* refers to the claws, the hooked thorns.
culture.sw: Jina lake lina maana ya 'mgunga wenye kucha': *chikwata* ni jina la jumla la Kidigo la migunga, na *kombe* linarejelea kucha, yaani miiba iliyopinda kama ndoano.

names.en: In Digo it is *chikwata kombe*. *Chikwata*, the general name for acacias, is shared with Duruma, Giriama and Swahili. In English it is called hook-thorn or black-thorn. No specific Swahili name has been recorded.
names.sw: Kwa Kidigo ni *chikwata kombe*. *Chikwata*, jina la jumla la migunga, linatumika pia katika Kiduruma, Kigiriama na Kiswahili. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *hook-thorn* au *black-thorn*. Hakuna jina mahususi la Kiswahili lililorekodiwa.

reason.en: Albizia, a related tree in the same family
